episode_title: Real Estate Research: The Truth About Property Prices in India | PropertyAngel Podcast Ep16

real_qa.q: What is the IIM Bangalore real estate research model for commercial property price discovery?
real_qa.r: Professor Venkatesh and his team created a statistical model that overcomes limitations of transaction-based indices by using space and time parameters. The model analyzes the entire history of price changes not just in a specific locality but across surrounding areas to determine what market price any property would achieve, even if it had no recent transaction. This approach was applied to Grade A and Grade A Plus commercial rental properties in partnership with CRE Matrix.
real_qa.requete: IIM Bangalore commercial property price index model

real_qa.q: What premium do buyers pay for properties with clean government titles versus private titles in Bangalore?
real_qa.r: In Bangalore, researchers found that buyers are willing to pay approximately 6 percent extra premium for land acquired through government sources like BDA auctions compared to similar privately-held land after controlling for all other factors including infrastructure quality. This premium reflects the value of clean title, as government land automatically removes all previous title defects.
real_qa.requete: clean title premium Bangalore real estate

real_qa.q: Why does under-construction property sales pose unique pricing risks in India?
real_qa.r: In India, developers start selling under-construction properties from day one with nothing on the ground, unlike the rest of the world where buildings are completed before sale and funded through debt. This creates risk at various stages of development, with the bulk of returns for residential projects occurring at the early stage when risk is highest, and returns declining significantly if investors enter later in the project lifecycle.
real_qa.requete: under-construction property risk India real estate

real_qa.q: How does the IIM Bangalore model account for property uniqueness in residential pricing?
real_qa.r: The model breaks property valuation into three categories: location-driven attributes such as proximity to metro or economic clusters, property-driven attributes like finishes and amenities, and builder attributes related to brand value. The model then determines which attributes are important and how their premium value changes over time, recognizing that features like swimming pools were once significant differentiators but are now standard.

real_qa.q: What data sources can improve residential property valuation beyond registration records?
real_qa.r: Mortgage data can be overlaid on registration data to provide better market valuation approximations. Banks conduct independent valuations through independent valuers for lending decisions, which reveal true market values more accurately than registration values that may be based on government guideline values or circle rates. Properties registered above guideline value represent a truth-telling population closest to actual market prices.
real_qa.requete: mortgage data residential property valuation India

real_qa.q: When will the CRE Matrix IIM Bangalore commercial property index be available?
real_qa.r: The index was first made publicly available in December through the IIM Bangalore site and CRE Matrix site. The next version incorporating stakeholder feedback will be released in March and will be announced every quarter thereafter after being frozen.
real_qa.requete: CRE Matrix IIM Bangalore index launch date
